name: NURS 5811
title: Application of Genetics to Healthcare
description: This course is required of all graduate students in the Advanced Practice programs (APRN). The purpose of the master’s program is to prepare advanced practice nurses with specialized knowledge, skills and values. Graduates assume leadership roles in the health care system and advance practice and the discipline of nursing by applying existing nursing knowledge and using a spirit of inquiry to examine and test nursing knowledge. Exploration of the application of genetics and genomics to the delivery of precision healthcare.
requirement_description: Open to Nursing graduate students, others with consent.
